title: Understanding the Effectiveness of LLMs in Automated Self-Admitted Technical Debt Repayment
review_status: full-text audit complete; dataset construction, manual filter validation, metrics, results, and validity limits checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 submitted 2025-01-17; preprint record checked
evidence_note: Constructs 58,722 Python and 97,347 Java repayment examples; manually validated 100 candidates per language and reports Llama-3-70B precision/recall 0.830/0.867 (Python) and 0.926/0.806 (Java). Best exact match is 10.1% Python/8.1% Java. LEMOD measures line overlap with one later developer patch, not semantic correctness; generated repairs were not functionally tested. Possible training-data contamination and within-method scope remain.

title: Benchmark Dataset Generation and Evaluation for Excel Formula Repair with LLMs
review_status: full-text audit complete; seed/synthetic construction, human agreement, paired performance, and limits checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 submitted 2025-08; KDD 2025 paper per manuscript
evidence_note: 618 generated FoRepBench examples are compared with a 59-example real seed. Execution-match falls from 0.80 to 0.41 for GPT-4.1, 0.73 to 0.35 for GPT-4o, 0.58 to 0.24 for Phi-3, and 0.51 to 0.19 for Mistral. Human annotator kappa is 0.60; LLM agreement is 0.42 in the results table, while the conclusion reports 0.25. The internal discrepancy is preserved. Scope is single-sheet English Excel.

title: A Survey on Large Language Model Impact on Software Evolvability and Maintainability: the Good, the Bad, the Ugly, and the Remedy
